title: Data-Driven Dynamic Portfolio Selection with Vine Copula Simulation and Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.20037v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a data-driven approach to dynamic portfolio selection that combines vine-copula simulation with reinforcement learning. The investor has constant relative risk aversion and maximises expected terminal utility with a running penalty on the conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) of one-period losses. We estimate a conditional vine model from historical returns and use it to generate joint scenarios for CVaR evaluation and conditional paths for training a recurrent portfolio policy. Under uniform local derivative bounds, we propagate edgewise pair-copula parameter errors through the conditional transforms to obtain power-law stability bounds in Hellinger distance and total variation. translated_title: 基于藤Copula模拟与强化学习的数据驱动动态投资组合选择
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一种将藤Copula模拟与强化学习相结合的数据驱动动态投资组合选择方法。投资者具有常数相对风险厌恶，其目标是在最大化期望终端效用的同时，对单期损失的条件风险价值施加持续惩罚。我们从历史收益率中估计条件藤模型，并利用该模型生成用于CVaR评估的联合情景，以及用于训练循环神经网络投资组合策略的条件路径。在一致局部导数界的假设下，我们通过条件变换传播逐边二元Copula参数误差，得到了Hellinger距离和全变差下的幂律稳定性界。在有限期投资模型中，我们将这些估计与边际和结构近似预算相结合，为策略价值、最优价值以及在拟合模型下所选策略的真实市场损失提供上界，并将模拟误差与数值误差分别处理……
tldr: 本文提出一种融合藤Copula模拟与强化学习的数据驱动动态投资组合选择框架，并从理论上证明了逐边二元Copula参数误差在Hellinger距离和全变差下呈幂律传播，据此为策略价值与真实市场损失给出可验证的稳定性界。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a data-driven dynamic portfolio selection framework combining vine-copula simulation with reinforcement learning, and theoretically shows that edgewise pair-copula parameter errors propagate with power-law stability bounds in Hellinger distance and total variation, which are used to bound policy values and the true-market loss.
